body:
### Describe the bug

`gh issue develop <n> -R OWNER/REPO --name <branch> --base <base>`, run from a directory that is not inside a git repository, creates the linked branch on GitHub, then exits 1 with `failed to run git: fatal: not in a git directory` and prints no URL. A branch that was created reads as a failed command, and a script that checks the exit code treats it as a failure. Repeating the command with the same `--name` outside a repository fails the same way, because the existing-branch path reaches the same step.

The cause is the order in `developRunCreate`: after `CreateLinkedBranch` succeeds ([develop.go#L261](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go#L261)), the `--base` value is written as `branch.<name>.gh-merge-base` with `git config` ([#L278-L283](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go#L278-L283)), and an error there returns before the URL is printed ([#L285](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go#L285)). The local steps after the URL already allow running outside a repository: `checkoutBranch` returns nil when no remotes are found, unless `--checkout` was given ([#L353-L364](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go#L353-L364)). The branch-config write is the one local step that assumes a repository. This code is the same on `trunk` (674516f) and in v2.103.3.

Related, not duplicates: the write came with the `gh-merge-base` support in #9712 (for #10089). #12575 and #12651 fixed a different failure of the same line (an empty branch name written into `.git/config`). #9072 asks in general for no repository requirement where an operation does not touch one; here the remote work succeeds and only the local base-branch hint fails.

### Affected version

```
gh version 2.96.0 (2026-07-02)
https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.96.0
```

Also reproduced with the latest release:

```
gh version 2.103.3 (2026-10-26)
https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.103.3
```

git version 2.50.1, Linux aarch64.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

Use a repository `OWNER/REPO` where you can create branches, an issue `<n>` in it with no linked branches, and an empty directory that is not inside a git repository. Times are UTC, 2026-10-28.

1. In the empty directory, gh 2.96.0, 14:47:24: `gh issue develop <n> -R OWNER/REPO --name <branch-a> --base main`. Exit 1, stdout empty, stderr `failed to run git: fatal: not in a git directory`. Afterwards `gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/branches/<branch-a>` returns the branch and `gh issue develop --list <n> -R OWNER/REPO` lists it.
2. Control, same directory without `--base`, 14:47:26: `gh issue develop <n> -R OWNER/REPO --name <branch-b>`. Exit 0, prints `github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/<branch-b>`.
3. Control, step 1's command in a fresh `git init` directory with no remotes, 14:47:28: `gh issue develop <n> -R OWNER/REPO --name <branch-c> --base main`. Exit 0, prints `github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/<branch-c>`, and `git config --get branch.<branch-c>.gh-merge-base` there returns `main`.
4. Step 1 with gh 2.103.3, 14:47:44: `--name <branch-d>`. Exit 1, the same error, stdout empty, branch created.
5. Step 4 repeated with the same `--name <branch-d>`, 14:47:45. Exit 1, the same error; `GH_DEBUG=true` shows the failing call is `git config branch.<branch-d>.gh-merge-base main`.
6. Step 4 with a new name and `GH_DEBUG=true`, 14:47:53: `--name <branch-e>`. Exit 1, branch created; debug log below.

Before this reproduction the same failure showed up twice in normal use (2026-10-27 11:40Z and 2026-10-28 13:13Z), both run outside any repository, and in both GitHub's repository activity records the branch creation at the time of the failing call.

### Expected vs actual behavior

Expected: outside a repository, `--base` creates the branch, prints its URL and exits 0, as the command does without `--base`. The command's own code sets that behaviour for the other local steps: the test case "develop new branch outside of local git repo" in [develop_test.go](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop_test.go#L582) expects the URL and no error, and `checkoutBranch` bails out silently when "the command was not run from inside a git directory" ([#L356-L358](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go#L356-L358)). Inside a repository, `branch.<name>.gh-merge-base` is still written. With `--checkout`, an error outside a repository stays, as `checkoutBranch` already returns one.

Actual: exit 1, `failed to run git: fatal: not in a git directory`, no URL on stdout, and the linked branch exists on GitHub.

The existing outside-a-repository test case sets no `BaseBranch`, so this path has no test today; a `--base` variant of that case would cover it.

### Logs

```
# 2026-10-28T14:47:24Z, empty directory outside any git repository, gh 2.96.0
$ gh issue develop <n> -R OWNER/REPO --name <branch-a> --base main
failed to run git: fatal: not in a git directory
# exit 1, stdout empty

# 2026-10-28T14:47:26Z, same directory, no --base
$ gh issue develop <n> -R OWNER/REPO --name <branch-b>
github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/<branch-b>
# exit 0

# 2026-10-28T14:47:28Z, fresh git init directory with no remotes
$ gh issue develop <n> -R OWNER/REPO --name <branch-c> --base main
github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/<branch-c>
# exit 0
$ git config --get branch.<branch-c>.gh-merge-base
main

# 2026-10-28T14:47:35Z
$ gh issue develop --list <n> -R OWNER/REPO
<branch-a>	https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/<branch-a>
<branch-b>	https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/<branch-b>
<branch-c>	https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/tree/<branch-c>
```

<details><summary>GH_DEBUG=true, gh 2.103.3, step 6 (new branch, empty directory), full stderr, timestamps cut to milliseconds</summary>


comments.body:
Thanks for the detailed report and investigation! I verified the cited source at commit [674516f](https://github.com/cli/cli/commit/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de):

- In [`developRunCreate`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go#L278-L283), after the linked branch is created on GitHub, `opts.GitClient.SetBranchConfig(...)` is called unconditionally whenever `--base` is set, before the URL is printed and before `checkoutBranch` runs.
- [`SetBranchConfig`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/git/client.go#L493-L503) shells out to `git config branch.<name>.gh-merge-base <base>` with no guard for "not in a git directory", so it returns an error that aborts the command before the URL line is reached.
- By contrast, [`checkoutBranch`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/674516ff39ccdaa8a525873f87552609dcda63de/pkg/cmd/issue/develop/develop.go#L353-L364), which runs later, already tolerates being invoked outside a git repository (it swallows the "no remotes found" error unless `--checkout` was passed).

This matches the reported symptom: the remote linked branch is created successfully, but the local `git config` write fails and the command exits 1 without printing the branch URL, even though the equivalent run without `--base` succeeds. Suggesting `bug` and the `gh-issue` command label; `priority-3` since the remote operation itself succeeds and a workaround exists (run from inside a git repo). No duplicate found — related issues (#12986, #13805, #9072, #12575, #12651) address different failure modes of `gh issue develop`.
